benchmark_name: General Offline Research & Information Retrieval Evaluation Suite

scientific_and_biological_systems.query: Compare CRISPR-Cas9 and Prime Editing for targeted genetic modification
key_facts: CRISPR-Cas9 creates double-strand breaks (DSBs) repaired by NHEJ or HDR
Prime editing uses an engineered reverse transcriptase fused to a Cas9 nickase
Prime editing uses a prime editing guide RNA (pegRNA) to write edits directly without DSBs
Prime editing significantly reduces unintended indels compared to standard CRISPR-Cas9

scientific_and_biological_systems.query: Explain how mRNA vaccines stimulate immunity compared to inactivated viral vaccines
key_facts: mRNA vaccines deliver lipid nanoparticle (LNP) encapsulated genetic code for spike protein
Host ribosomes synthesize the viral antigen endogenously
Triggers both MHC Class I (cytotoxic CD8+ T cells) and MHC Class II (CD4+ helper T cells) responses
Inactivated vaccines use chemically killed whole virions stimulating primarily humoral antibody responses

scientific_and_biological_systems.query: How did the Haber-Bosch process transform global agriculture and what are its environmental impacts?
key_facts: Synthesizes ammonia (NH3) from atmospheric nitrogen (N2) and hydrogen (H2)
Requires high temperatures (400-500 C) and high pressures (15-25 MPa) over an iron catalyst
Sustains global synthetic fertilizer production feeding approximately half of the human population
Consumes 1-2% of global energy and drives significant greenhouse gas emissions and aquatic eutrophication

historical_and_economic_analysis.query: What are the primary hypotheses explaining the Late Bronze Age Collapse around 1200 BCE?
key_facts: Destruction of Mycenaean, Hittite, and Levantine civilizations in the Eastern Mediterranean
Invasions and raids by seafaring confederations collectively termed the Sea Peoples
Evidence of prolonged regional megadroughts and agricultural failure
Systemic collapse of interconnected diplomatic trade routes and tin/copper bronze supply chains

historical_and_economic_analysis.query: Why did ancient Roman maritime concrete exhibit greater longevity than modern Portland cement?
key_facts: Formulated with volcanic ash (pozzolana), quicklime, and seawater
Seawater reaction dissolves volcanic elements and precipitates aluminum tobermorite and phillipsite crystals
Post-curing mineral growth self-heals microcracks rather than eroding
Modern Portland cement lacks this reactive mineral growth and degrades under sulfate and chloride attack

historical_and_economic_analysis.query: Compare the systemic causes of the 1929 Great Depression with the 2008 Global Financial Crisis
key_facts: 1929 driven by stock market speculation, deflation, wave of unregulated commercial bank runs, and gold standard rigidity
2008 triggered by subprime mortgage securitization, credit default swaps, and shadow banking liquidity freeze
1930s exacerbated by Federal Reserve monetary contraction and Smoot-Hawley protectionist tariffs
2008 mitigated by coordinated central bank quantitative easing, zero-interest-rate policy, and bank recapitalizations

cryptographic_protocols.query: Compare EIP-7702 and ERC-4337 for Ethereum account abstraction
key_facts: EIP-7702 introduces transaction type 0x04 allowing EOAs to temporarily designate contract code per transaction
ERC-4337 operates via an alternative mempool with UserOperations and an EntryPoint contract without consensus changes
EIP-7702 preserves existing EOA addresses and private keys while enabling transaction batching and sponsorship
ERC-4337 requires deploying distinct smart contract wallet instances (e.g., Safe)

cryptographic_protocols.query: Compare Falcon and ML-DSA post-quantum signature schemes for blockchain execution
key_facts: Falcon produces compact signatures (~666 bytes for Falcon-512) minimizing on-chain calldata costs
ML-DSA produces larger signatures (~2420 bytes for ML-DSA-44)
Falcon requires floating-point arithmetic with FFT-based trapdoor Gaussian sampling over NTRU lattices
ML-DSA uses strictly modular integer polynomial arithmetic (NTT) over module lattices

cryptographic_protocols.query: Explain KZG polynomial commitments versus FRI for data availability and zero-knowledge proofs
key_facts: KZG provides O(1) constant-size proofs (48 bytes on BN254) and O(1) elliptic curve pairing verification
KZG requires a trusted setup ceremony (Powers-of-Tau) and relies on discrete logarithm assumptions
FRI (used in STARKs) is transparent without trusted setup and relies strictly on collision-resistant hash functions
FRI proofs are significantly larger (tens of kilobytes) than KZG commitments

cryptographic_protocols.query: Explain Proposer-Builder Separation (PBS) and its role in MEV mitigation
key_facts: Decouples the block proposer (validator) role from the transaction ordering and block building role
Prevents home validators from needing sophisticated algorithmic MEV extraction pipelines
Currently executed out-of-protocol via MEV-Boost relays with builder auctions
Long-term Ethereum roadmap targets in-protocol ePBS to remove centralized relay dependencies

distributed_systems.query: Compare PBFT and Tendermint consensus protocols in Byzantine fault-tolerant networks
key_facts: Both tolerate up to f Byzantine faults out of 3f + 1 nodes (under partial synchrony)
PBFT uses three phases: pre-prepare, prepare, and commit with view changes
Tendermint simplifies the round-based flow with propose, prevote, and precommit
Tendermint locks validators to specific blocks across rounds to streamline view transitions

distributed_systems.query: Compare Zero-Knowledge Rollups and Optimistic Rollups in finality, proof generation, and capital efficiency
key_facts: ZK-Rollups offer cryptographic validity proofs (SNARKs/STARKs) with immediate L1 state finality upon proof verification
Optimistic Rollups assume valid execution and require a 7-day challenge window for fraud proofs
ZK-Rollups require high computational overhead for prover generation but provide instant asset withdrawal
Optimistic Rollups have cheap execution but delay bridge capital liquidity unless using third-party liquidity providers

key_facts: Ao 26 - Vegan Food Project located in Chiado (Rua Vitor Cordon 26)
Kong - Food Made With Compassion located in Baixa (Rua do Crucifixo 105)
Organi Chiado offering organic, seasonal macrobiotic dishes at Calcada Nova de Sao Francisco

geospatial_and_field_lookup.query: How does offline GNSS trilateration compute device position without cell towers or network access?
key_facts: Receives one-way radio time-of-arrival signals from at least 4 GPS/Galileo/GLONASS satellites
Calculates pseudoranges by multiplying propagation delay by the speed of light (c)
Uses 4 satellites to solve for 4 unknowns: three-dimensional spatial coordinates (X, Y, Z) and receiver clock bias (t)
Operates completely passively with zero outbound radio transmission
